prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_screen] Account Existing Pet Sync Check: Inserts a explicit cloud sync status badge and pet recovery check component directly on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, leading to account confusion.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Preview Split Redesign: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a split view layout with instant live pet previews alongside option selection. (why: Adoption step has a steep drop (60.9% conversion) and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s).)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Error Rescue Flow: Rebuilds the photo upload screen into a two-column design featuring photo quality guidelines and immediate preset fallbacks. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures and distorted pet visuals.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection: Reorders the journey so pet selection occurs before account registration, allowing users to fall in love with their pet first. (why: Sign in currently happens right after path choice, causing early dropoff before users experience pet customization.)
4: [home, hint] Desktop Placement Diagnostics Hint: Adds explicit troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen explaining desktop engine startup and tray icon location. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to launch post-setup.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Stage Breakdown: Replaces the generic waiting message with stage-by-stage progress breakdown and estimated completion timer. (why: Home wait step shows very long mean duration (2336s) causing users to abandon during pet rendering.)
6: [adoption, notification] Certificate Name Auto-Save Indicator: Adds an active verification badge and auto-save feedback when typing pet name on the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption flow median duration is high (89s median / 1017s mean) partly due to uncertainty during certificate completion.)
